continuousMorphPathBound.method: Per-row minimum distance from infinite straight shaft axis to the convex 2D projection of all six healthy/mature endpoints. Encloses each corresponding whole triangle throughout continuous linear morph. Includes both tangent walls and arbitrary intermediate blends; does not approximate by vertex distances alone.

grip.boundMethod: Whole transformed tool triangles project inside endpoint radial cylinder and axial range; radial/axial ranges hold over every point of each triangle. Compare with whole continuous-morph floor hull bound, using 0.001 mm numerical reserve. Finite tool pose sampling, not a universal clinical claim.
